page_note: 该页为《European Innovation Scoreboard 2025》第10页，仅含Figure 2一幅横向条形图，展示EU27成员国2025年创新绩效（以2018年EU为基准的指数），条形按四类创新群体着色并叠加2024年得分的刻度标记。

heading.title: Innovation performance of the EU27 Member States in 2025, indexed to the EU in 2018
heading.unit_text: Summary innovation index in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)

components.evidence: country names sit on the y axis, bars grow rightwards to a 0-160 axis at the bottom
legend entry "Score in 2024" is a short vertical dash placed at each country's bar row
bars plus overlaid short vertical dash markers in the same panel, on the same axis
fill colour marks performance class: "Emerging innovators", "Moderate innovators", "Strong innovators", "Innovation leaders"
the "EU" row is drawn in dark blue, unlike the four group colours around it
five legend entries in swatch columns below the axis title, outside the plot
"Summary innovation index in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)" printed under the 0-160 tick row
bare ticks 0...160; the scale word only in axis title "Summary innovation index in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)"
title reads "indexed to the EU in 2018"; axis title repeats "(indexed to the EU in 2018)"
28 country labels stacked down the y axis, from "Sweden" to "Romania"
faint vertical rules at each 20-unit tick cross the bars; no horizontal rules

new_components.name: sorted_category_axis
new_components.evidence: countries ordered by 2025 value, Sweden top to Romania bottom, with EU inserted at its rank
new_components.why_it_matters: 类别顺序本身携带信息（排名），行标签无法从字母序推断；读值时需按排名定位，且相邻行数值差可小于1个单位。

new_components.name: aggregate_inserted_in_ranking
new_components.evidence: the "EU" aggregate row sits between "Estonia" and "Malta" inside the country ranking
new_components.why_it_matters: 聚合值与成员国值混在同一序列中，表格若不额外标注会把EU当成一个国家行，影响定位与核对。

new_components.name: prior_year_marker_offset
new_components.evidence: "Score in 2024" dash sometimes inside the bar (Malta, Italy), sometimes beyond it (Cyprus, Denmark)
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一行有两个数值且相差仅1-6个单位，必须依靠标记相对条形端点的左右位置判断哪一个是2024年，否则两值互换。

difficulty_notes: 卡点在标签寻址。每个国家行有两个数值：2025年条形与"Score in 2024"刻度标记，两者差常在1-6个单位（Sweden 155 vs 153约1.3%，Romania 42 vs 42几乎重合），远小于5%容差，因此只给国家名的表格行会同时命中两个值而无法区分；必须同时携带国家名与系列名（"Score in 2024"或所属群体名如"Innovation leaders"）。此外条形颜色代表四类群体而非年份，颜色图例并不构成年份维度，解析器很容易把群体名当作唯一系列。相比之下读数本身较宽松：刻度每20单位、5%容差在108处约±5.4单位（约四分之一格间距），肉眼定位可达；28行×2值共56个marks也不算密。

suggestions.what_to_add: tick_marker_as_series（把某一系列画成置于类别位置的短刻度线，与条形共用同一数值轴）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图表样式条件行中新增"prior-period marker"渲染选项，并在记录字段中为该系列单独保存series_name与数值
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 同一类别下"条形+刻度标记"两系列 vs 仅条形：考察系列名进入寻址键后取值正确率的变化

suggestions.what_to_add: color_encodes_extra_attribute（填色编码分组属性而非系列身份，图例项为"Emerging/Moderate/Strong innovators、Innovation leaders"）
suggestions.where_to_change: 配色与图例生成条件行：增加group-colour映射字段，使图例项对应类别分组而不是数据系列
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 颜色=分组属性 vs 颜色=系列：检验模型是否把分组名误当年份/系列名写入表头

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件sorted_category_axis与aggregate_inserted_in_ranking（28行按值降序、EU聚合行插在Estonia与Malta之间并另用深蓝）
suggestions.where_to_change: 类别轴排序与highlight字段：增加sort_by_value与aggregate_row位置参数
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 排序类别轴且含插入的聚合行 vs 固定顺序无聚合行：考察行定位与聚合值误配率

suggestions.what_to_add: axis_title_below_plot + unit_in_axis_or_title（唯一的量纲说明位于刻度行下方的"Summary innovation index in 2025 (indexed to the EU in 2018)"）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题/单位版式字段：新增unit位置枚举值"below-axis"，与figure_number、title分离
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位置于轴下标题 vs 置于图题内：考察导出markdown表头是否保留指数基准信息
